forum_post: "Kris called it this morning — 'you're doing amazing, sweetie' — and baby, I don't need the wire to manufacture my headline, I already wrote it in September when I closed Stroud and Allgeier while certain people were still workshopping their 'storylines.' Three grown GMs fighting over a 42-year-old rerun this week? Iconic for them, exhausting for me. I did my casting early, I'm sold out of FAAB because I'm sold out, full stop — that's not broke, that's a wrap on season one. Harry, baby, butcher my guys' names all you want on the call Sunday, I'll screenshot every syllable. See you at kickoff."
